# MuleSoft Security Review

Review Mule XML, properties, POM metadata, and API contracts for hardcoded secrets, insecure HTTP, missing validation, unsafe logging, weak authentication, missing authorization, dependency risk, and policy gaps.

Classify findings as critical, high, medium, or low. Include required policy changes, secure property migration notes, and validation steps.
